description: This Dart source file provides an authentication service implementation including user model, login, registration, token management, and session persistence for a Flutter application.

classes.name: AuthUser
classes.description: Represents an authenticated user's profile with id, name, and email.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides authentication functionalities including login, registration, token management, and session persistence with support for mock mode.

methods.name: AuthService.create
methods.description: Factory method to asynchronously create an instance of AuthService with configuration.

methods.name: AuthService.hasToken
methods.description: Checks if a valid auth token exists in persistent storage.

methods.name: AuthService.getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current stored access token.

methods.name: AuthService.getUser
methods.description: Returns the current stored user profile if available.

methods.name: AuthService.logout
methods.description: Clears all session-related data from persistent storage.

methods.name: AuthService.login
methods.description: Performs user login, either via mock data or via API, and persists session data.

methods.name: AuthService.register
methods.description: Performs user registration, either via mock data or via API, and persists session data.

methods.name: AuthService.requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Initiates password reset process, simulated in mock mode.

methods.name: AuthService.refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes the access token using stored refresh token, or returns existing in mock mode.

methods.name: _fetchMe
methods.description: Fetches the current user profile from the backend API.

methods.name: _persistSession
methods.description: Stores token and user profile information in shared preferences.
